lanes.summary: The app only checks whether the `club` entitlement is active. It never mentions a billing problem or a grace period, and when the entitlement goes away the guard sends the person to the hard paywall, so their recipes are locked (not deleted) with no free tier. Fix: F5 (lapsed → re-subscribe without data loss) + F2(a). Grace-period access depends on App Store Connect/RevenueCat config, unverified.

lanes.summary: Signing in restores everything. RevenueCat logs in with the account id and syncs once per account, the onboarded flag lives on the account so the intro is skipped, and the paywall has Restore purchases with named outcomes. Small miss: a fresh phone opens on Sign up, not Sign in, and you reach Sign in from a link (F1 'I have an account').

You can start deletion in the app from the Account tab or from the paywall (for non-members). One native confirm explains what is lost and offers Manage subscription to members, Apple users confirm once more so their tokens are revoked, then the server erases photos, data and the user, and the app signs out to Sign in. No ticket item needed (the gaps ticket marks it as passing).

Inside the app, offline is a state: one quiet banner that takes no touches, the persisted cache stays readable, and queries pause and resume. A cold start offline counts on RevenueCat's on-device cache (unverified), a fresh install fails closed onto the paywall, and an app update throws the offline cache away. Offline mutations are not persisted. G14 done; offline launch → F5.
